evidence: In fluxer_api/src/api/channel/services/thread/ThreadMappers.ts, mapThreadToResponse, which serializes created and listed threads, maps a thread channel
In fluxer_api/src/api/channel/ChannelMappers.ts and services/thread/ThreadMappers.ts, every community channel and thread is serialized with the guild_id of its community
In fluxer_api/src/api/channel/ChannelMappers.ts, serializeGuildChannelFields sends name as channel.name ?? undefined, so a community channel never has a null name
In fluxer_api/src/api/channel/ChannelMappers.ts, the DM, group DM and personal notes serializers send no guild_id
In fluxer_api/src/api/channel/ChannelMappers.ts, addDMRecipients lists the other recipient of every DM
In fluxer_api/src/api/channel/services/thread/ThreadCreationService.ts, storeThread writes the parent's guild_id on every thread, which ThreadMappers.ts sends
In fluxer_api/src/api/channel/services/thread/ThreadCreationService.ts, storeThread writes parent_id on every thread, which ThreadMappers.ts always sends
In fluxer_api/src/api/channel/services/thread/ThreadCreationService.ts, storeThread writes owner_id on every thread, which ThreadMappers.ts always sends
In fluxer_api/src/api/channel/services/thread/ThreadCreationService.ts, storeThread writes the required thread name, which ThreadMappers.ts always sends
In fluxer_api/src/api/channel/services/thread/ThreadMappers.ts, mapThreadToResponse always sends thread_metadata
In fluxer_api/src/api/channel/services/ChannelRequestService.ts, a thread is serialized by mapThreadToResponse, and ThreadCreationService.ts writes parent_id on every thread
In fluxer_api/src/api/channel/services/ChannelRequestService.ts, a thread is serialized by mapThreadToResponse, and ThreadCreationService.ts writes owner_id on every thread
In fluxer_api/src/api/channel/services/ChannelRequestService.ts, a thread is serialized by mapThreadToResponse, and ThreadCreationService.ts writes the required thread name
In fluxer_api/src/api/channel/services/ChannelRequestService.ts, a thread is serialized by mapThreadToResponse, which always sends thread_metadata
In fluxer_api/src/api/channel/services/thread/ThreadMappers.ts, mapThreadToResponse sends invitable for every private thread
In fluxer_api/src/api/channel/services/thread/ThreadMappers.ts, mapThreadMemberToResponse sends user_id unless withIds is false, which no caller passes
In packages/schema/src/domains/guild/GuildRequestSchemas.ts, members set accent_color only as a ColorType from 0 through 16777215
In fluxer_api/src/api/search/GlobalSearchService.ts, hits_per_page echoes the request, which packages/schema/src/domains/message/MessageRequestSchemas.ts limits to 1 through 25
In fluxer_api/src/api/search/GlobalSearchService.ts, page echoes the request, which packages/schema/src/domains/message/MessageRequestSchemas.ts limits to 1 through 400
In fluxer_api/src/api/guild/controllers/GuildMemberSearchController.ts, total_result_count is the search engine's hit count, which is never negative
In fluxer_api/src/api/search/guild_member/GuildMemberSearchSerializer.ts, the discriminator is padded to four digits
In fluxer_api/src/api/search/guild_member/GuildMemberSearchSerializer.ts, joined_at is stored as whole seconds since the epoch
